scope: Parent closure of completed, hash-bound independent probe evidence; independent reviewer stopped before writing a prose final report. Native database execution and QA semantics are separate.
probe_scope: No R67 grant reuse; no authorization or budget balance creates permission
48 challenge aggregate and all grounding/tool/abstention gates
100 new answers; 97 confirmed and conservative control and six abstentions
500 fresh selection and original judge, unknowns retain full denominator
Explicit failure/unknown-usage stop without automatic retry
Strict pytest terminal summary plus real process exit codes and command/log/source binding
known_fixed_finding: The original freeze text-only check accepted collection-error summaries; strict terminal counts and actual subprocess evidence now reject them.
limits: Final 500 result must be independently audited from all outputs, raw judge verdicts, traces and costs; a target-met flag alone is insufficient.
